literal: In pleasure pleasure he who does not desire, in sorrow sorrow experiencing he is without.
translation: He who does not crave pleasure in times of joy will not suffer sorrow in times of trouble.
modern: இன்பம் வரும் காலத்தில் அதனை விரும்பி மயங்காதவன், துன்பம் வரும் காலத்தில் அதற்காக வருந்த மாட்டான்.
explanation: This couplet teaches the importance of emotional equanimity. The word 'விழையாதான்' describes a person who does not actively crave or cling to joy when circumstances are favorable. Because this person does not attach themselves to fleeting happiness, they do not experience 'துன்பம்' (sorrow) as a crushing burden when facing difficulties. The parallel structure emphasizes that maintaining balance during good times is the very foundation of resilience during bad times.
